title: Freeze Dance Song for Kids 🧊 Freeze Like Ice! | Brain Break Movement Game | Tiny Turn Up
description:
When the music stops, you FREEZE! 🧊 A fun freeze dance song and movement game for kids ages 3–7. Freeze like a robot, a flamingo, a superhero and more with Jojo, Kiki and Waddles!

Great for classroom brain breaks, indoor recess, PE, preschool circle time and dance parties.

New Tiny Turn Up dance songs every week!
#freezedance #brainbreak #kidsdance
